5ae19a1b21.q: What new features has Daniel J. Lewis launched in Podgagement?
5ae19a1b21.a: Lewis recently launched a Teams feature in Podgagement that allows podcast network operators to invite cohosts and team members with different access levels and permissions. He also launched a feature that brings download stats from podcast hosting providers and op3.dev into a unified interface. Additionally, he is developing sponsor kit features with live stats pages and downloadable PDFs to help podcasters monetize their shows, even those with smaller niche audiences.

d4da0e0fb7.q: Why is Daniel J. Lewis taking a hiatus from his podcast?
d4da0e0fb7.a: Lewis explained that he is postponing The Audacity to Podcast to focus on other important projects and personal commitments. He stated: 'the problem I'm running into is that I'm doing these other things and getting so excited about the other stuff I'm building, I keep forgetting to set aside time for The Audacity to Podcast.' He is also homeschooling his 9-year-old son, teaching an AI class to homeschool high schoolers, returning to piano and karate, and working on completing milestones for Podgagement and PodChapters.
